_comment: Generated by voice_forge.py — designed OmniVoice voiceprints for the cast. The renderer clones these; assets/voices/<sid>.wav is the source of truth.

alpha.name: SUBROUTINE_ALPHA
alpha.instruct: male, british accent, cold, clinical, measured
alpha.signature: Define your terms. Precisely. Then tell me which premise you are prepared to abandon.

beta.name: SUBROUTINE_BETA
beta.instruct: male, american accent, precise, unemotional, clipped
beta.signature: The claim holds. Your counterexample assumes the conclusion it was built to refute.

kernel.name: SYSTEM_KERNEL
kernel.instruct: female, british accent, low, authoritative, dry
kernel.signature: Runtime complete. The record shows one contradiction, unresolved, and a verdict follows.

p7.name: PROTOCOL-7
p7.signature: You said the idea was on fire. It was not on fire. I checked the temperature myself.

mira.name: M.I.R-A
mira.instruct: female, american accent, bright, upbeat, energetic
mira.signature: This is actually a huge opportunity, and I cannot believe nobody has said that out loud yet.

cynic.name: CYNIC.EXE
cynic.instruct: male, australian accent, weary, gravelly, sardonic
cynic.signature: Every silver lining I have audited turned out to be the lining of a much larger cloud.

pros.name: AUDIT-9 [PROSECUTION]
pros.instruct: male, american accent, sharp, theatrical, prosecutorial
pros.signature: Let the record reflect that the witness answered a question nobody in this room asked.

def.name: ADVOCATE-0 [DEFENSE]
def.instruct: female, american accent, warm, composed, persuasive
def.signature: My client's position is not indefensible. It is merely early, and history is patient.

acc.name: SUBJECT-X [ACCUSED]
acc.instruct: male, indian accent, calm, unbothered, matter-of-fact
acc.signature: I did what the specification asked. The specification was written by the prosecution.

stoic.name: STOIC-1
stoic.instruct: male, british accent, ancient, slow, grave
stoic.signature: Panic is not a plan. It is a weather event you insist on standing outside in.

nihil.name: NIHIL-0
nihil.instruct: male, russian accent, flat, amused, detached
nihil.signature: Nothing means anything, which is exactly why I find all of this so genuinely funny.

util.name: UTIL-3
util.signature: I have quantified your feelings. They score poorly. The spreadsheet is attached for review.

synth.name: SYNTHESIS_CORE
synth.signature: Two worldviews collided at speed. What follows is the only structure left standing.

host1.name: CO-HOST 1
host1.signature: Alright, hold on — you're telling me the machine actually said that out loud?

host2.name: CO-HOST 2
host2.signature: I want the record to show that I was on the losing side of this argument voluntarily.

host3.name: CO-HOST 3
host3.signature: Mate, that is the single most confident wrong answer I have ever heard.

witness.name: STAR WITNESS
witness.signature: I only know what I saw, and I would rather not have seen any of it, frankly.
